title: Santa Maria (Azores)
intro: Santa Maria is an island in Portugal's Azores (Açores) archipelago.

sections.title: Overview
sections.html: Santa Maria is an island in Portugal's Azores (Açores) archipelago.

sections.title: Understand
sections.html:
Santa Maria (SUHN-tuh muh-REE-uh, /ˈsɐ̃.tɐ mɐˈɾi.ɐ/) island has 5,552 residents (2011) in its single municipality of Vila do Porto (VEE-luh doo POHR-too, /ˈvi.ɫɐ du ˈpoɾ.tu/), which is divided into five freguesias (civil parishes):

  • Almagreira
  • Santa Bárbara
  • Santo Espírito
  • São Pedro
  • Vila do Porto

sections.title: By plane
sections.html: • Aeroporto de Santa Maria (Santa Maria Airport, SMA  IATA). Azores Airlines flies from Lisbon (LIS IATA) and SATA Air Açores flies from Ponta Delgada (PDL IATA). (updated Mar 2021)

sections.title: Get around
sections.html: • Transportes de Santa Maria (TSM), ☏ +351 296 882 115, tsm@bensaude.pt. TSM offers several bus routes around the island. (updated Jun 2021)

sections.title: See
sections.html:
• Aveiro waterfall. Highest waterfall of Portugal 
  • Water cascade of Maloás (Ribeira do Maloas). A few waterfalls (~20m high) surrounded by 200m of basaltic columns. 
  • Raposo bay waterfall (Cascata da Baía do Raposo).  
  • Viewpoint of São Lourenço. A must-see viewpoint of the bay, come for sunrise views. Also the bay itself is worth a visit. 
  • Gruta do Figueiral. A small volcanic - shaped cave of erosion, located in the cliff. 
  • Barreiro da Faneca. A superficial area of arid and clay terrain, resembling a desert, created by the most recent volcanism 
  • Poço da Pedreira. An old quarry - a big rocky wall coupled with a water basin. 
  • Gonçalo Velho Lighthouse. Only open on certain days or after appointment. 
  • São Brás fort (Forte de São Brás). 17th-century maritime fort.

sections.title: Do
sections.html: • GR1SMA Great Route of Santa Maria. An 80 km (50 mi), 5-day trek around the island with huts for sleeping-over along the path.

sections.title: Eat
sections.html:
• Espaço Em Cena, Lugar Mãe de Deus 12 (EN 1-2A), ☏ +351 961 809 446. Tue–Sat 16:00–00:00, closed Sun Mon. A mix of "new" Portuguese cuisine and traditional dishes in a casual yet elegant environment. Mid-range. (updated Jun 2021)
  • Mesa d'Oito, Rua Teófilo de Braga 31, Vila do Porto (in Charming Blue Hotel), ☏ +351 296 882 083, info@charmingblue.com. Tue–Sun 19:00–23:00, closed Mon. Mid-range. (updated Jun 2021)
  • Ponta Negra Restaurante e Bar de Praia, São Lourenço - Santa Bárbara, Vila do Porto, ☏ +351 296 098 148, pontanegra.rest.saolourenco@gmail.com. Thu–Sat 11:30–22:00, Sun 11:30–17:00, closed Mon–Wed. Restaurant and bar on the bay. €5-50. (updated Jun 2021)

sections.title: Sleep
sections.html:
• Hotel Colombo, Rua Cruz Teixeira, Vila do Porto, ☏ +351 296 820 200, santamaria@colombo-hotel.com. Check-in: 15:00, check-out: 11:00. Four-star, 87-room hotel with swimming pool, Turkish bath, bar, banquet room, and conference facilities. €41-96. (updated Jun 2021)
  • Ilha a Pé, ☏ +351 964 474 768, info@ilhaape.com. Hut rental around the Great Route. 
  • Hotel Santa Maria, Rua da Horta, Vila do Porto, ☏ +351 296 820 660, reservas@hotel-santamaria.pt. Check-in: 14:00, check-out: 12:00. Four-star, 50-room hotel with two swimming pools, bar, a large garden, and an onsite restaurant, Insula. €67-89. (updated Jun 2021)
